label: Arrows and Shift
try: The map, the keyboard on it. Every tap of an arrow is one tile, and a held arrow keeps a steady pace. Shift with an arrow jumps 9 across and 6 up or down. Press g from anywhere to go back to your Nexus. Press d to change the steps and paces under KEYBOARD NAVIGATION.

label: Shift is slow
try: Arrows move five tiles, Shift with an arrow moves one: Shift is the precise move, the arrow the quick one. Tap, hold, and nudge with Shift. In a menu or a list the arrows still move one row.

label: Fast hold
try: A held arrow moves at every repeat your keyboard sends instead of the game's steady pace. Hold an arrow and compare. Hold pace, under KEYBOARD NAVIGATION, brings the game's pace back.
